data.Shelter Finding: Ability to identify and utilize natural environmental features, like rocky overhangs, to protect from harsh weather conditions.
data.Snow Melting for Water: Ability to source water in snowy environments by melting snow, a critical survival skill in cold climates.

data.Foraging for Edible Roots: Skill in identifying and gathering edible roots in sparse forest environments, crucial for survival when food availability is limited.
data.Rodent Trapping: Ability to catch small rodents as a food source in mountainous and forest terrains.
data.Predator Awareness: Enhanced vigilance and awareness of active predatory birds and other wildlife, critical for safety in high danger environments.
data.Energy Conservation: Skill in managing energy levels by prioritizing tasks and resting strategically to maintain health in challenging environments.
